description.zh:
API的客户端请求签名方法，可选值：

- HmacSHA256
- HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
description.en:
The type of the two-way communication API. Valid values:

- **COMMON**: general APIs

- **REGISTER**: registered APIs

- **UNREGISTER**: unregistered APIs

- **NOTIFY**: downstream notification

description.zh: API编号
description.en: The ID of the API.

description.zh: API的名称，组内不允许重复。支持汉字，英文，数字，下划线，且只能以英文和汉字开头，4~50个字符
description.en: The name of the API. The name must be unique within the API group. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

description.zh:
支持AppCode的认证类型。可选值：

- DEFAULT：默认值：上架云市场后支持
- DISABLE： 不支持AppCode调用方式
- HEADER  ：仅在Header中支持
- HEADER_QUERY ：可以在Header或者Query中支持
description.en: The ID of the backend service.

description.zh:
API安全认证类型，目前可以取值：

- **APP**：只允许已授权的APP调用
- **ANONYMOUS**：允许匿名调用，设置为允许匿名调用需要注意：
     - 任何能够获取该API服务信息的人，都将能够调用该API。网关不会对调用者做身份认证，也无法设置按用户的流量控制，若开放该API请设置好按API的流量控制。
     - “ANONYMOUS”API**不建议上架云市场**，网关无法对调用者区分计量，也无法限制调用次数，若所在分组要上架云市场，建议将该API转移至其他分组，或将类型设置为“私有”，或选择“阿里云APP”认证方式。
description.en: The configuration items of API requests sent by the consumer to API Gateway.

description.zh: 是否启用后端服务
description.en: Configuration Mode

description.zh: 后端服务ID
description.en: Specifies whether to enable backend services.

description.zh: 网关发送给后端服务的常量参数
description.en: The constant parameters sent by API Gateway to the backend service.

description.zh: API描述信息，最多180个字符
description.en: The description of the API. The description can be up to 180 characters in length.

description.zh:
- 设置DisableInternet为**true**，仅支持内网调用API。
- 设置DisableInternet为**false**，则不限制调用。

> 修改API时，不设置则不修改原来的取值。
description.en:
The AppCode authentication type supported. Valid values:

- DEFAULT: supported after being made available in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace

- DISABLE: not supported

- HEADER : supported only in the Header parameter

- HEADER\_QUERY: supported in the Header or Query parameter

description.zh:
后端服务返回的错误码示例。

更多信息，请参见[ErrorCodeSample](~~44392~~)。
description.en:
The sample error codes returned by the backend service.

For more information, see [ErrorCodeSample](~~44392~~).

description.zh:
后端服务失败返回应答的示例。
该值仅用于生成文档使用。不对返回结果产生影响。
description.en: The sample error response from the backend service. This value is used only to generate documents. It does not affect the returned result.

description.zh:
- 设置**ForceNonceCheck**为**true**, 请求时强制检查X-Ca-Nonce，这个是请求的唯一标识，一般使用UUID来标识。API网关收到这个参数后会校验这个参数的有效性，同样的值，15分内只能被使用一次。可以有效防止API的重放攻击。
- 设置**ForceNonceCheck**为**false**, 则不检查。修改时，不设置则不修改原来的取值。
description.en:
- Specifies whether to set DisableInternet to **true** to limit API calls to within the VPC.

- If you set DisableInternet to **false**, the limit if lifted.

> If you do not set this parameter, the original value is used.

description.zh: 指定的分组编号
description.en: The ID of the API group.

description.zh: 第三方账号认证OpenID Connect相关配置项
description.en:
The client-side request signature method of the API. Valid values:

- HmacSHA256

- HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256

description.zh: Consumer向网关发送API请求的相关配置项
description.en: The configuration items of API requests sent by API Gateway to the backend service.

description.zh:
Consumer向网关发送API请求的参数描述。

更多信息，请参见[RequestParameter](~~43986~~)。
description.en:
The parameters of API requests sent by the consumer to API Gateway.

For more information, see [RequestParameter](~~43986~~).

description.zh: api的返回结果
description.en:
- Specifies whether to set **ForceNonceCheck** to **true** to force the check of X-Ca-Nonce during the request. This is the unique identifier of the request and is generally identified by UUID. After receiving this parameter, API Gateway verifies the validity of this parameter. The same value can be used only once within 15 minutes. This helps prevent replay attacks.

- If you set **ForceNonceCheck** to **false**, the check is not performed. If you do not set this parameter, the original value is used.

description.zh: API的返回说明
description.en: The descriptions of API responses.

description.zh: 后端服务返回应答的示例 该值仅用于生成文档使用。不对返回结果产生影响。
description.en: The sample response that is returned from the backend service. This value is used only to generate documents. It does not affect the actually returned result.

后端服务返回应答的格式，目前可以设置为：JSON、TEXT、BINARY、XML、HTML。
该值仅用于生成文档使用。不对返回结果产生影响。

The parameters of API requests sent by API Gateway to the back-end service.

For more information, see [ServiceParameter](~~43988~~).

Consumer向网关发送请求的参数和网关向后端服务发送的请求的参数的映射关系。

The mappings between parameters of requests sent by the consumer to API Gateway and parameters of requests sent by API Gateway to the back-end service.

For more information, see [ServiceParameterMap](~~43989~~).

description.zh: 网关发送给后端服务的系统参数
description.en: The system parameters sent by API Gateway to the backend service.

description.zh:
API是否公开，目前可以取值：

- **PUBLIC**：公开，如选择此类型，该API的线上环境，会在所有用户的控制台“发现API”页面展示
- **PRIVATE**：不公开，如选择此类型，当该组API在云市场上架时，私有类型的API不会上架
description.en:
Specifies whether the API is public. Valid values:

- **PUBLIC**: Make the API public. If you set this parameter to PUBLIC, this API is displayed on the APIs page for all users after the API is published to the production environment.

- **PRIVATE**: Make the API private. Private APIs are not displayed in the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace after the API group to which they belong is made available.

description.zh:
双向通信API类型：

- **COMMON**：普通API
- **REGISTER**：注册API
- **UNREGISTER**：注销API
- **NOTIFY**：下行通知
description.en: The returned description of the API.

descriptions.zh:
**"** 此接口面向开放API的用户
- 该接口需要全量更新，不支持部分参数更新
- 修改ApiName时需要注意，同一个分组内API不允许重名
- 修改RequestPath时需要注意，同一个分组内Path不允许重复
- 该接口调用的QPS限制为：单用户QPS不超过50
descriptions.en:
**This operation is intended for API providers.**

- This API operation requires a full update. Updates of partial parameters are not supported.

- When you modify an API name, make sure that the name of each API within the same group is unique.

- When you modify the request path, make sure that each request path within the same group is unique.

- The QPS limit on this operation is 50 per user.
